label: over-the-shoulder
text: framed past the near figure's shoulder onto the far figure
note: Needs two figures in fixed relative position. Across a carry, subject scale is the pin most likely to break.

label: over-the-hip
text: framed past the near figure's hip onto the far figure

label: group shot
text: a group held in one frame

label: point of view
text: the frame the subject is seeing
note: Implies the camera inherits the subject's motion. Pairs with handheld more often than with static.

label: reaction shot
text: close on a face responding to what was just shown

label: master shot
text: the whole scene played through in one wide frame
note: A coverage concept. Has no meaning in a 25-97 frame envelope — listed so a parser can reject it.

label: cutaway
text: a frame away from the main action
note: Always a cut, never a carry.

label: establishing shot
text: the frame that places the scene

label: special effects shot
text: a shot whose content is an effect
note: Marks a shot for the effects pipeline. See notation/etc-movielabs-vfx-is.
